sections.section_title: Write down values and approximate values up to 4 decimal places
sections.content_markdown:
19. Write down values and approximate values up to 4 decimal places :
1) $\sqrt{2}$ 
2) $0.\dot{2}\dot{5}$ 
3) $1.\dot{3}\dot{4}$ 
4) $5.1\dot{3}0\dot{2}$

sections.section_title: Write down which of the following numbers are rational and irrational
sections.content_markdown:
20. Write down which of the following numbers are rational and irrational:
1) $0.\dot{4}$ 
2) $\sqrt{9}$ 
3) $\sqrt{11}$ 
4) $\frac{\sqrt{6}}{3}$ 
5) $\frac{\sqrt{8}}{\sqrt{7}}$ 
6) $\frac{\sqrt{27}}{\sqrt{48}}$ 
7) $2\frac{3}{7}$ 
8) $5.\dot{6}3\dot{9}$

sections.section_title: Prove that n^2 when divided by 8 gives 1 as remainder
sections.content_markdown: 21. Let $n = 2x - 1$, where $x \in N$. Prove that $n^2$ when divided by 8 gives 1 as remainder.

22. $\sqrt{5}$ and 4 are two real numbers.
1) Specify which one is rational and which one is irrational.
2) Find two irrational numbers between $\sqrt{5}$ and 4.
3) Prove that $\sqrt{5}$ is an irrational number.
